# jamfplatform_pro_smtp_server (Data Source)

Read the current Jamf Pro SMTP Server settings (Settings → System → SMTP Server). Singleton — one record per tenant. WriteOnly secrets are never returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read the current Jamf Pro SMTP Server settings. WriteOnly secrets are never returned.
data "jamfplatform_pro_smtp_server" "current" {}

output "smtp_authentication_type" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_smtp_server.current.authentication_type
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `authentication_type` (String) Authentication method: `NONE`, `BASIC`, `GRAPH_API`, or `GOOGLE_MAIL`.
- `basic_auth_credentials` (Attributes) Basic credentials (present for BASIC). Only the non-secret username is readable. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--basic_auth_credentials))
- `connection_settings` (Attributes) SMTP relay connection (present for NONE / BASIC). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connection_settings))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the SMTP server connection is enabled.
- `google_mail_credentials` (Attributes) Google Workspace credentials (present for GOOGLE_MAIL). The client secret is never readable. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--google_mail_credentials))
- `graph_api_credentials` (Attributes) Microsoft Graph API credentials (present for GRAPH_API). The client secret is never readable. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--graph_api_credentials))
- `id` (String) Fixed singleton identifier. Always `singleton`.
- `sender_settings` (Attributes) Sender identity applied to outbound mail. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sender_settings))

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--basic_auth_credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `basic_auth_credentials`

Read-Only:

- `username` (String) SMTP account username.


<a id="nestedatt--connection_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connection_settings`

Read-Only:

- `connection_timeout` (Number) Connection timeout, in seconds.
- `encryption_type` (String) Connection encryption protocol.
- `host` (String) SMTP server hostname or IP.
- `port` (Number) SMTP server port.


<a id="nestedatt--google_mail_credentials"></a>

Read-Only:

- `client_id` (String) Google OAuth client ID.
